descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță pentru externalizare și delocalizare, Dezvoltare de software și Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
We are seeking an inquisitive and talented Senior QA Engineer to join our SCRUM development team for a complex media project. You will design and execute tests, build automation frameworks, continuously contribute to the overall test strategy, and ensure high-quality delivery within CI/CD pipelines.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Test Automation & Strategy: Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable test automation frameworks while defining coding standards and reducing flakiness.
 UI & API Testing: Validate web applications (especially Angular) and microservices architectures (.NET/C#), covering contract, integration, and end-to-end testing layers.
 DevOps & CI/CD: Integrate automated tests into cloud-based pipelines (AWS/Azure/GitHub Actions) and define quality gates.
 Data & Caching Validation: Handle test data setup and investigation using SQL and NoSQL technologies (Redis, Elasticsearch).
 Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in SCRUM ceremonies, translate business requirements into testable acceptance criteria, and proactively challenge requirements where quality risks exist.
 Technical Requirements & Skills: 
 Automation Languages: Strong programming ability in C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript .
 UI Testing Automation: Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress , Selenium, or similar.
 API Testing Tools: Proficiency with Postman, Swagger, Insomnia, and experience with contract testing, mocking, and stubbing.
 Design Patterns: Deep understanding of POM (Page Object Model), Screenplay, API client abstraction, and reusable test fixtures.
 Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and environment configuration management.
 Databases: Strong SQL skills (NoSQL/Elasticsearch/Redis experience is a plus).
 QA Practices: Mastery of test design techniques (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Tables, Exploratory Testing).
 Core Soft Skills: 
A proactive communicator comfortable making pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed and quality.
Strong documentation skills for test strategies, automation guidelines, and release readiness reports.
